environment: Chromium production export at /preview/; mocked EIP-1193 wallet and JSON-RPC; no real transactions

tests.name: Production subpath loads; disconnected actions disabled; no wallet recovery
Unknown wallet chain adds exact supplied chain, switches again, then enables actions
Free give simulates and submits with zero tip and no approval
Tip total is count × per-kudo; exact approval precedes give; balances refresh
Withdraw pulls entire credit and disables a second withdrawal
Invalid recipient, self, zero, count, precision, overflow and insufficient balance never request a transaction
Wallet rejection and simulation errors are shown with no broadcast
Account change during simulation prevents signing
Account and chain events invalidate spending state
Leaderboard aggregates count by recipient, deduplicates logs and uses complete epoch range
Failed event range shows an error instead of a partial leaderboard
Missing code, wrong RPC chain and token binding mismatch gate writes
Changing a paid plan requires fresh approval; a new epoch blocks a stale give
Keyboard-only connect, approve, give and withdraw flow
Desktop/mobile/intermediate reflow, keyboard focus, reduced motion and accessibility audit
